title: திருக்குறள் 10 பாடல்கள் மனப்பாடம்
description: Memorise Thirukkural couplets 101 to 110 and write their meaning in your notebook.

title: Exercise 4.2 — Linear Equations
description: Complete sums 1 to 12 from Exercise 4.2. Show every step of the working.

title: Diagram: Parts of a Flower
description: Draw and label the parts of a flower on an unruled sheet. Bring it to the lab session.

title: Letter to the Headmaster
description: Write a formal letter requesting leave for two days. Minimum 120 words.

title: Map work — Rivers of Tamil Nadu
description: Mark the Cauvery, Vaigai, Thamirabarani and Palar on the outline map provided.

title: HTML practice
description: Create a simple web page about your favourite festival using headings, lists and an image.
